name: Panel
summary: In-flow collapsible content container. A semantic <section> with a labeled header (h2/h3) and a body, optionally collapsible via a chevron in the header. Three variants — plain (in-page section), bordered (Card-flavored section), and inspector (a docked right-rail panel that can resize). The de-facto 'settings group' / 'inspector panel' primitive.

collapsible.description: Adds a chevron to the header that collapses the body. Use <details> semantics under the hood for free SR support.

headingLevel.description: Semantic heading level for the header label.

leading.description: Optional leading slot (Avatar, IconButton, status dot) before the title.

trailing.description: Trailing action slot — typically a small Button or DropdownMenu trigger.

resizable.description: variant='inspector' only. Adds a left-edge drag handle that the consumer wires to width state.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to collapse trigger (when collapsible)
rules: Heading uses the level passed via headingLevel — outline structure should remain sane (don't drop from h2 to h4).
Collapsible variant uses <details>/<summary> + .lumen-summary so the native marker is suppressed per AGENTS.md hard rule 14.
Inspector variant's resize handle is keyboard-resizable (arrow keys + Home/End).

do: Use Panel for in-flow page sections (Settings → Profile, Settings → Notifications).
Use variant='bordered' on Cards-as-sections inside a docs body.
Use variant='inspector' for the docked right rail on a doc / kanban / collaboration surface.
Pair with Form for grouped form fields.
dont: Don't use Panel as a Card replacement when there's no heading — that's just a Card.
Don't make every Panel collapsible — it adds disclosure cost without clear value.

changelog.note: Initial Panel contract. Plain / bordered / inspector variants. Collapsible + resizable modes.
